subkey_lookup.notes: Builds a UNICODE_STRING from the row key string and forwards it into the child-entry search helper at 0x1407E3394.

value_lookup.notes: Adds 0x24 to the located key object and calls 0x14086C510.

value_lookup_inner.notes: Case-insensitively compares the requested UTF-16 value name against entry strings and returns STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND with out index -1 on miss.

value_copy.notes: Copies the located value blob into the target pointer supplied by the row.
